measurements.title: AVID Reference Ruby — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.system_title: AVID Acutus / AVID Nexus / AVID Reference Ruby
measurements.summary: The AVID Reference Ruby, Acutus and Nexus chain averaged 37.6 dB of in-system channel separation at 1 kHz, with +0.43 dB signal balance (L−R). Groove Scope Studio rated 90 µm and 100 µm clean in a separate tracking capture. The intervening 80 µm band was rated severe and had a much weaker fundamental.

measurements.title: Takumi Aka MC — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.system_title: Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC / Takumi Aka MC
measurements.summary: The Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC averaged 33.33 RPM under stylus load with 0.030% DIN-shaped wow and flutter RMS. The measurer observed excellent vibration rejection and moderate tracking ability. The crosstalk capture followed azimuth adjustment, with cartridge alignment still imperfect in the measurer’s assessment. The measurer flagged a possible sample defect as a contributor to the crosstalk result. Low capture level may have limited the crosstalk and harmonic readings.
measurements.search_text: GS-2026-0015 1 kHz Reference Check Takumi TT Level 2.1 DC Takumi Aka MC ART preamp USB Audio CODEC

measurements.title: Charisma Audio MC-1 Alpha — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.system_title: SME Model 12 MkII / SME Series V / Charisma Audio MC-1 Alpha
measurements.summary: At Entertainment Machine in Rome, the SME Model 12 MkII averaged 33.32 RPM under stylus load and measured 0.038% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. With the SME Series V and Charisma Audio MC-1 Alpha fitted, the chain measured less than 1% THD in each channel and a 5.57 dB gap between crosstalk directions.

measurements.title: Rega Carbon — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: At the AudioReview laboratory, Groove Scope guided an azimuth adjustment that narrowed the Rega Carbon’s directional crosstalk gap from 10.27 dB to 1.16 dB and brought average separation to 31.8 dB. In a separate Groove Scope Studio tracking trial, the Rega P1 and Carbon reached 80 µm at 2.5 g after stopping at 60 µm at 2.0 g.
measurements.search_text: GS-2026-0013 1 kHz Reference Check Rega P1 Rega Carbon ART preamp USB Audio CODEC

measurements.title: Ortofon 2M Bronze — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: Measured as fitted, the New Horizon with an Ortofon 2M Bronze averaged 33.41 RPM and 0.053% DIN-shaped wow and flutter RMS. The Groove Scope Studio speed fingerprints show a recurring pattern whose angular position and shape change across eight revolutions.
measurements.search_text: GS-2026-0012 1 kHz Reference Check New Horizon Ortofon 2M Bronze ART preamp

measurements.title: Audio-Technica VM95SH — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.system_title: Thorens TD 160 Super / SME III / Audio-Technica VM95SH
measurements.summary: Groove Scope made it easy to improve the azimuth from a much poorer starting point. After adjustment, this setup measured 17.7 dB average channel separation at 1 kHz. The Audio-Technica VM95SH used in the session had a bent cantilever, so the cartridge readings apply to this compromised specimen. The Thorens averaged 33.29 RPM, and both Rotation Fingerprints showed a speed pattern that repeated each turn and warrants further investigation.
measurements.search_text: GS-2026-0011 1 kHz Reference Check Thorens TD 160 Super SME III Audio-Technica VM95SH ART preamp

measurements.title: Shure V15 V — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.system_title: Micro Seiki DQX500 / Micro Seiki MA707 / Shure V15 V
measurements.summary: An original Shure V15 V with a new JICO Custom Shop MR stylus gives an encouraging result in this Micro Seiki DQX500 / MA707 / Audio Research SP20 / Audient EVO4 capture: 33.33 RPM (−0.02%), 0.025% DIN-shaped wow and flutter, −0.01 dB channel balance and 27.3 dB average separation. THD measured 0.65% left and 0.49% right. The measurer describes clear, revealing sound before break-in and a surprisingly quiet background; the report calls for a repeat of the right-channel third-harmonic check before setup changes.
measurements.search_text: GS-2026-0010 1 kHz Reference Check Micro Seiki DQX500 Micro Seiki MA707 Shure V15 V JICO Custom Shop MR Audio Research SP20 Audient EVO4

measurements.title: BENZ SPJ — Hi Fidelity Milan
measurements.system_title: VYGER Atlantis / VYGER INERTIAL / BENZ SPJ
measurements.summary: Measured as found in the CHARIO Academy room at Hi Fidelity Milan, with no setup adjustments: the BENZ SPJ / VYGER Atlantis / VYGER INERTIAL / ART USB Phono Plus chain averaged 33.33 RPM (−0.01%), with 0.032% DIN-shaped wow and flutter, 27.4 dB average separation and +0.49 dB channel balance. Harmonics were steady during recording. The measurer reports a successful 100 µm tracking-ladder pass and credits the new INERTIAL tonearm as a major contributor to that performance.

measurements.title: Ortofon 2M Bronze — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: The Ortofon 2M Bronze delivers strong 1 kHz separation in this Rega P3 / Audio Research SP20 / EVO4 capture: 32.8 dB on average, with +0.53 dB channel balance. Playback averaged 33.34 RPM (+0.01%) with 0.027% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. THD was 0.98% left and 1.13% right; repeat the right-channel third-harmonic check before changing setup.

measurements.title: Goldring 2100 — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: The DQX-500 capture averaged 33.33 RPM (−0.01%) with 0.032% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. Average 1 kHz separation was 20.1 dB and channel balance was −0.54 dB. The right-channel third harmonic changed most during recording, so the report advises repeating the capture before adjusting the cartridge setup.

measurements.title: Empire 7000/III — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.summary: The Technics SL-1410 MK2 averaged 33.33 RPM (−0.01%) with 0.040% DIN-shaped wow and flutter. Separation averaged 23.8 dB, but the two crosstalk directions differed by about 2 dB; channel balance was −0.26 dB. Harmonics stayed steady within this recording, while THD was higher on the left (2.26%) than the right (1.85%).

measurements.title: Transfiguration Orpheus — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.system_title: Micro Seiki RX-5000 / SME V / Transfiguration Orpheus
measurements.summary: The RX-5000 averaged 33.51 RPM, or +0.52%, while DIN-shaped wow and flutter measured 0.031%. That combination separates a notably high mean-speed reading from low measured rotational variation in this capture; it does not identify the cause. Average separation was 19.5 dB, and harmonic levels were reported steady during recording.
measurements.search_text: GS-2026-0006 1 kHz Reference Check Micro Seiki RX-5000 SME V Transfiguration Orpheus EVO4

measurements.title: Audio-Technica AT-OC9XML — 1 kHz Reference Check
measurements.system_title: Rega P3 / Rega RB330 / Audio-Technica AT-OC9XML
